notes: «بهذا» is the short form of «بهذا الإسناد»: a final back_reference link, since no previous report is supplied and the text writes its own names.
«وفي الباب عن أبي بكر الصديق» is a remark about another report in the chapter, and «ولا يصح حديث أبي بكر» is a judgment: neither is a route of this saying, left out.
